payload.reason: The evidence describes a meta-learning algorithm that utilizes a meta network to share knowledge across tasks, specifically through a functional sharing scheme with a Meta-LSTM architecture.

claims.text: The algorithm uses a Meta-LSTM architecture for meta-learning, which captures shared knowledge across tasks.
The meta network in the algorithm controls the parameters of task-specific networks, allowing for efficient knowledge transfer.
The proposed model improves performance on new tasks by leveraging the meta knowledge stored in the meta network.
